extracted.title: Scaffolding in relation to Demolition works package - HS2 Euston Station
extracted.description:
The subcontract works comprise of the design, procurement, and management of the scaffold installation to support the demolition of the Podium and planters to Ground Level, including all interfacing elements, materials, resources and associated plant and equipment. Please find attached document with high level overview, including satellite imagery. 
      
      These works must be co-ordinated with the temporary works of the Demolition Contractor and that of the RDG Engineering (who are a specialist temporary works designer, who under an ECI, are developing the temporary works solution to keep the Transport for London (TfL) bus station operational underneath the Podium, during its demolition.
      
      These works must be carried out with minimal disruption to the operational station, bus station and existing pedestrian flows.
      
      The subcontractor must be a NFDC member and have a RISQS accreditation (if you don't have a current RISQS accreditation you must commit to obtaining one within 10 weeks of contract award)
